data.description:
Found while verifying d724 AC10 against Windows sweep 35551741150.

tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py::test_copy_repoints_sibling_origin_and_keeps_refs_isolated fails on Windows. After copying a store, the copy's `origin` still points at the SOURCE's `origin.git` sibling rather than being relocated into the copy. The copy is therefore not self-contained for remotes, so a fetch/push from the copy reaches the source store's remote.

This is NOT the d724 defect class: no PermissionError, and the copied .tickets-tracker/.git pointer is rewritten correctly. Distinct root cause, unfixed, no investigation done yet.

The Windows sweep is continue-on-error and broadly red (1596 distinct failures), so this is invisible at job level.
data.title: Windows copy leaves origin pointing at the source sibling remote
